`astronaut.png` is the public-domain NASA photograph of astronaut Eileen Collins used in scikit-image's sample data.

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/v0.19.3/skimage/data/astronaut.png
Documentation: https://scikit-image.org/docs/stable/api/skimage.data.html#skimage.data.astronaut

Used solely to run real face-detection/reconstruction integration tests. Not served as a selectable or default avatar. No endorsement implied.

`grace_hopper.jpg` is a public-domain U.S. Navy portrait of Rear Admiral Grace Hopper, distributed with Matplotlib.
Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/matplotlib/matplotlib/v3.8.0/lib/matplotlib/mpl-data/sample_data/grace_hopper.jpg
Used only to verify that another person's photograph produces a different avatar.
